summary: The change adds a GST helper but it returns only the tax, not the amount with tax, so the test fails. It also commits an API key and leaves a breakpoint in.

findings.title: API key committed in code
findings.detail: A live-looking key is hard-coded. Anyone with the repository can use it.
findings.suggestion: Remove it, rotate the key, and read it from an environment variable.

findings.title: with_gst returns the tax, not the total
findings.detail: amount * rate gives 180 for 1000; the test expects 1180.

findings.title: breakpoint() left in
findings.detail: Any call to with_gst stops the program in production.

praise: Default GST rate as a parameter makes other rates easy to support.
